params.name: type
params.description: Type of logs to retrieve, either "build" or "runtime". Defaults to "runtime".

params.name: app_id
params.description: (Optional) Filter on the provided app_id. At least one of app_id, service_id, deployment_id, regional_deployment_id or instance_ids must be set.

params.name: service_id
params.description: (Optional) Filter on the provided service_id. At least one of app_id, service_id, deployment_id, regional_deployment_id or instance_ids must be set.

params.name: deployment_id
params.description: (Optional) Filter on the provided deployment_id. At least one of app_id, service_id, deployment_id, regional_deployment_id or instance_ids must be set.

params.name: regional_deployment_id
params.description: (Optional) Filter on the provided regional_deployment_id. At least one of app_id, service_id, deployment_id, regional_deployment_id or instance_ids must be set.

params.name: instance_id
params.description: Deprecated, prefer using instance_ids instead.

params.name: instance_ids
params.description: (Optional) Filter on the provided instance_ids. At least one of app_id, service_id, deployment_id, regional_deployment_id or instance_ids must be set.

params.name: stream
params.description: Deprecated, prefer using streams instead.

params.name: streams
params.description: (Optional) Filter on stream: either "stdout", "stderr" or "koyeb" (for system logs).

params.name: start
params.description: (Optional) Must always be before `end`. Defaults to 15 minutes ago.

params.name: end
params.description: (Optional) Must always be after `start`. Defaults to now.

params.name: order
params.description: (Optional) `asc` or `desc`. Defaults to `desc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: (Optional) Defaults to 100. Maximum of 1000.

params.name: regex
params.description: (Optional) Apply a regex to filter logs. Can't be used with `text`.

params.name: text
params.description: (Optional) Looks for this string in logs. Can't be used with `regex`.

params.name: regions
params.description: (Optional) Filter on the provided regions (e.g. ["fra", "was"]).
